title: San Juan de Oriente
goal: Watch pottery being made and ask how long it took to learn
culture: In this village the pottery goes four or five generations deep in most houses. Ask about the years rather than the technique — the years are the answer he wants to give you.

beats.es: (Está centrando el barro con el pie en el torno.)
beats.objective: Ask how long it took to learn
beats.en: How long did it take you to learn?
beats.good: Ask the years, not the technique. The years are the answer he would rather give.

beats.es: Uf. Desde chavalo ando en esto.
beats.good: Desde chavalo — since I was a kid. The same word Roberto taught you next door, now describing a whole working life.

beats.es: Mi papá me enseñó. Y a él le enseñó el suyo.
beats.good: Mi papá from him, su papá from you. In this village the wheel goes four or five generations deep in most houses on the street.

beats.es: (Levanta la pieza terminada y se la enseña.)
beats.objective: Say the right thing about it
beats.good: Lindo rather than bonito, for something somebody made with their hands. It is a small choice and he will hear it.
